parameters.name: ReportId
parameters.description: The report ID. You can obtain the report ID by calling the [ListDiagnoseReportIds](~~183774~~) operation.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description:
The language in which the intelligent diagnostic report is generated. Default value: browser language. Valid values:

- en: English
- zh: Simplified Chinese
- zt: Traditional Chinese
- es: Spanish
- fr: French
